title: Energy Assistance Liaison Note: Pledges Held Back From the Amount Moved Into a Payment Arrangement
content:
*Energy assistance liaison note — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)*

**Pledge held back, to be paid by the agency.** The latest energy assistance pledge recorded on the member's Electric Service by Rate Schedule account within the tier's pledge lookback of 90 calendar days before the transfer day is held back from the amount moved into the agreement, to be paid by the agency, according to the pledging agency:

- a pledge from county emergency assistance or the Salvation Army is held back in full;
- a LIHEAP pledge is held back at 50 percent (0.5) of its amount;
- an Operation Round Up pledge, or no pledge, holds nothing back.

**Which pledge is read.** Only the latest pledge recorded on the service account is read, by its recording date, and only where it was recorded within the 90 calendar days before the transfer day; a latest pledge recorded earlier than that holds nothing back. Every tier carries the same 90-day lookback.

| Latest pledge, recorded within 90 days before the transfer day | Share of the pledge held back |
|---|---|
| county emergency assistance | in full |
| Salvation Army | in full |
| LIHEAP | 50 percent |
| Operation Round Up | nothing |
| no such pledge | nothing |

**Hypothetical pledges:** a $300.00 LIHEAP pledge recorded 20 days before the transfer day gives $150.00 held back; a $120.00 Salvation Army pledge recorded 45 days before gives $120.00; a $75.00 Operation Round Up pledge gives nothing; a county emergency assistance pledge recorded 95 days before gives nothing.
